suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-02) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` on 2026-10-09T21:35Z.

## Summary

`XlsxWorkbookSerializerCommon.cpp` uses `std::numeric_limits<int>` at lines 965-968 but its include block (lines 29-37: `algorithm`, `cctype`, `charconv`, `cstdio`, `memory`, `set`, `string`, `utility`, `vector`) has no `<limits>`. The error is independent of the `-Werror` setting.

## Environment

- Revision `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` (default branch `main`)
- Docker images `gcc:13` (13.5.0), `gcc:14` (14.4.0), `gcc:15` (15.3.0), `silkeh/clang:latest` (clang++ 22.1.8, libstdc++)

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp
cd Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp && git checkout 9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src gcc:14 bash -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq cmake ninja-build && cd /src/Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp && cmake -S . -B /tmp/b -G Ninja && cmake --build /tmp/b -- -k 0"
```

## Actual result

```
XlsxWorkbookSerializerCommon.cpp:965:24: error: 'numeric_limits' is not a member of 'std'
...:965:39: error: expected primary-expression before 'int'
...:966:27: error: 'numeric_limits' is not a member of 'std'
...:967:24: error: 'numeric_limits' is not a member of 'std'
...:968:27: error: 'numeric_limits' is not a member of 'std'
```
Identical with gcc 13.5.0 and 15.3.0. Clang 22.1.8: `no member named 'numeric_limits' in namespace 'std'`.

## Where in the repository

- `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/src/aspose/cells_foss/XlsxWorkbookSerializerCommon.cpp:965-968` (use) and `:29-37` (include list)
- Other translation units in the library that also use `std::numeric_limits` (`DisplayTextFormatter.cpp`, `XlsxWorkbookArchiveHelpers.cpp`)
